test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements :**

All space is wind.

Some wind is earth.

Some fire is earth.

**Conclusion (I) :** All earth is space.

**Conclusion (II) :** Some wind is fire.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a3353087cb9eecfa93b3d0c9f5e02a43915b7997ae4c8ae84ebbaabdf5522ec.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All earth is space → Does not follow (As all space is wind and some wind is earth. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some wind is fire → Does not follow (As some wind is earth and some fire is earth. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows**"
